shift(const mt &a, int shift)
{
    int k = int(a.size()) - 1;
    // left shift instead of right
    shift = (k - shift) % k;
    mt res = a;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            res[i][j] = a[(i + shift) % k][(j + shift) % k];
        }
    }

        for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {

import sys
import math

MOD = 1000000007

def shift(a, shift):
    k = len(a) - 1
    shift = (k - shift) % k
    res = [row[:] for row in a]
    for i in range(k):
        for j in range(k):
            res[i][j] = a[(i + shift) % k][(j + shift) % k]
    for j in range(k):
        res[k][j] = a[k][(j + shift) % k]
    return res

def multiply(a, b):
    n = len(a)
    k = len(a[0])
    m = len(b[0])
    aa = [[0 for _ in range(k)] for _ in range(n)]
    bb = [[0 for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(k)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(k):
            aa[i][j] = a[i][j]
    for i in range(k):
        for j in range(m):
            bb[j][i] = b[i][j]
    res = [[0 for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            tmp = 0
            for l in range(k):
                tmp = (tmp + (aa[i][l] * bb[j][l]) % MOD) % MOD
            res[i][j] = tmp
    return res

def main():
    n = int(input())
    k = int(input())
    max_depth = 0
    tmp = n
    while tmp != 0:
        max_depth += 1
        tmp //= k
    dp = [[] for _ in range(max_depth)]
    # constructing matrices for dynamic programming
    dp[0] = [[0 for _ in range(k + 1)] for _ in range(k + 1)]
    for i in range(k + 1):
        for j in range(k + 1):
            dp[0][i][j] = (i == j or j == 0)
    e = [[0 for _ in range(k + 1)] for _ in range(k + 1)]
    for i in range(k + 1):
        e[i][i] = 1
    for depth in range(1, max_depth):
        dp[depth] = e
        bs = dp[depth - 1]
        curx = k
        for i in range(int(math.log2(k)) + 1):
            if curx & (1 << i):
                dp[depth] = multiply(bs, shift(dp[depth], 1 << i))
                curx ^= (1 << i)
            bs = multiply(bs, shift(bs, 1 << i))
    base = [[0 for _ in range(k + 1)] for _ in range(1)]
    base[0][k] = 1
    sl = 0
    x = n
    vec = []
    while x != 0:
        vec.append(x % k)
        x //= k
    len = len(vec)
    for cur_depth in range(len - 1, -1, -1):
        rest = vec[cur_depth]
        for it in range(rest):
            sl = (sl + 1) % k
            base = multiply(base, shift(dp[cur_depth], sl))
    res = 0
    for i in range(k + 1):
        res = (res + base[0][i]) % MOD
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
